   294: /// M001 Darwin entry point: portable roles run against an intentionally
   295: /// unsupported host backend; privileged/network-mutating roles fail closed.
   296: ///
   297: /// `serve`, `admin`, `state`, `health`, `network status`, `doctor`, and
   298: /// `reconcile` execute with honest backend-unavailable degradation. `netd`,
   299: /// `system install/uninstall/status`, `update`, and mutating `network`
   300: /// paths that require a backend refuse with an actionable unsupported error
   301: /// rather than pretending convergence. No false-success receipt is possible:
   302: ///
   303: /// - `serve` starts the loopback HTTP surface and records
   304: ///   `BackendUnavailable` when netd is absent;
   305: /// - `reconcile`/`doctor` report unavailable instead of converging;
   306: /// - `state purge` refuses without a successful plan-only probe.
   307: #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
   308: fn run_darwin(command: Option<Command>) -> Result<(), String> {
   309:     match command {
   310:         None => {
   311:             println!(
   312:                 "wg-basic {}: use --help for runtime roles",
   313:                 env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")
   314:             );
   315:             Ok(())
   316:         }
   317:         Some(Command::Serve {
   318:             state,
   319:             socket,
   320:             http_bind,
   321:             canonical_origin,
   322:             allow_non_loopback,
   323:         }) => serve(
   324:             state,
   325:             socket,
   326:             http_bind,
   327:             canonical_origin,
   328:             allow_non_loopback,
   329:         ),
   330:         Some(Command::Reconcile { state, socket }) => {
   331:             let runtime = wg_basic::management::ManagementRuntime::open(&state, &socket)
   332:                 .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
   333:             match runtime
   334:                 .reconcile_current()
   335:                 .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?
   336:             {
   337:                 None => println!("no managed interface; nothing to reconcile"),
   338:                 Some(outcome) => println!(
   339:                     "generation {} -> {} ({:?})",
   340:                     outcome.applied_generation,
   341:                     if outcome.converged {
   342:                         "converged"
   343:                     } else {
   344:                         "not converged"
   345:                     },
   346:                     outcome.disposition
   347:                 ),
   348:             }
   349:             Ok(())
   350:         }
   351:         Some(Command::System { action }) => {
   352:             let _ = action;
   353:             Err("system install/uninstall is not supported on macOS in M001: Linux systemd layout only; launchd installation lands in M006".into())
   354:         }
   355:         Some(Command::Update { action }) => {
   356:             let _ = action;
   357:             Err("update check/run/recover is not supported on macOS in M001: no Darwin release target or trust root; see M006".into())
   358:         }
   359:         Some(Command::Health { state, socket }) => {
   360:             let runtime = wg_basic::management::ManagementRuntime::open(&state, &socket)
   361:                 .map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
   362:             println!(
   363:                 "{}",
   364:                 serde_json::to_string_pretty(&runtime.health())
   365:                     .map_err(|_| "could not format management health".to_owned())?
   366:             );
   367:             Ok(())
   368:         }
   369:         Some(Command::Doctor {
   370:             state,
   371:             socket,
   372:             json,
   373:             allow_warnings,
   374:             http_bind,
   375:             canonical_origin,
   376:             allow_non_loopback,
   377:         }) => run_darwin_doctor(
   378:             state,
   379:             socket,
   380:             json,
   381:             allow_warnings,
   382:             http_bind,
   383:             canonical_origin,
   384:             allow_non_loopback,
   385:         ),
   386:         Some(Command::Netd {
   387:             socket,
   388:             allowed_uids,
   389:             allowed_users,
   390:         }) => run_darwin_netd(socket, allowed_uids, allowed_users),
   391:         Some(Command::Admin { action }) => run_admin_action(action),
   392:         Some(Command::State { action }) => run_state_action(action),
   393:         Some(Command::Network { action }) => run_network_action(action),
   394:     }
   395: }

   397: /// M002 Darwin privileged network service.
   398: ///
   399: /// Binds the same narrow, authorized Unix-domain request/response service as
   400: /// Linux, with the Apple-documented `getpeereid(3)` credential source, the
   401: /// same bounded framing, and the same socket ownership/stale-inode lifecycle.
   402: /// Default policy is the current user only with no root bypass; `--allow-uid`
   403: /// and `--allow-user` add explicit management-service identities. Network
   404: /// operations beyond `Ping`/`InspectCapabilities` report `UnsupportedBackend`
   405: /// through the typed errors until M003–M005 land their backends.
   406: #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
   407: fn run_darwin_netd(
   408:     socket: std::path::PathBuf,
   409:     allowed_uids: Vec<u32>,
   410:     allowed_users: Vec<String>,
   411: ) -> Result<(), String> {
   412:     use std::sync::{atomic::AtomicBool, Arc};
   413:     use wg_basic::protocol::{AuthorizationPolicy, SocketServer};
   414: 
   415:     let mut policy = AuthorizationPolicy::current_user();
   416:     policy.extend(allowed_uids);
   417:     let resolved = wg_basic::distribution::resolve_allowed_user_uids(&allowed_users)
   418:         .map_err(|_| "could not resolve a configured local netd user".to_owned())?;
   419:     policy.extend(resolved);
   420:     let server = SocketServer::bind(&socket, policy)
   421:         .map_err(|_| "could not safely bind the configured netd socket path".to_owned())?;
   422:     let shutdown = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));
   423:     let signal_shutdown = shutdown.clone();
   424:     ctrlc::set_handler(move || signal_shutdown.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release))
   425:         .map_err(|_| "could not install graceful shutdown handler".to_owned())?;
   426:     wg_basic::operational::emit(
   427:         "netd.started",
   428:         wg_basic::operational::Severity::Info,
   429:         "netd",
   430:         "startup",
   431:         "ready",
   432:         None,
   433:         None,
   434:         Some("uds_listener"),
   435:     );
   436:     let result = server
   437:         .run_until_shutdown(&shutdown)
   438:         .map_err(|_| "netd listener stopped after a runtime error".to_owned());
   439:     wg_basic::operational::emit(
   440:         "netd.stopping",
   441:         wg_basic::operational::Severity::Info,
   442:         "netd",
   443:         "shutdown",
   444:         if result.is_ok() {
   445:             "graceful"
   446:         } else {
   447:             "runtime_error"
   448:         },
   449:         None,
   450:         None,
   451:         Some("uds_listener"),
   452:     );
   453:     result
   454: }
